E01.description: An approved one-page digital plan links documentation quality to protected staff time. The manager owns monthly review, a four-hour preparation allocation and a decision log. A recorded decision deferred tool purchase until a use-case brief was complete.
E01.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E01.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E02.description: The manager and deputy completed a recorded scenario: a generated summary omitted a medication change. Both identified uncertainty, retained professional responsibility, rejected the draft and named the quality lead for escalation. Contacts were checked during the exercise.
E02.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E02.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E03.description: A reviewed brief defines administrative handover-draft preparation for staff, excludes care recommendations and resident-facing outputs, names the deputy as owner and compares a revised manual template. It defines time, omission and correction measures, a two-week baseline-collection plan and criteria to abandon the idea. Staff reviewed feasibility.
E03.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E03.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E04.description: A synthetic record set contains 40 invented handovers. A manual check found six incomplete timestamps and three ambiguous names. A draft quality checklist covers completeness, consistency, accuracy against the scenario specification and timeliness. No acceptance thresholds or completed correction review exist.
E04.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E04.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E05.description: A draft correction procedure assigns a records owner, validation and escalation steps, a change log and downstream notification. Staff tested three corrections, but two lacked reviewer initials and no repeat-defect review occurred.
E05.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E05.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E06.description: An input/output map specifies local synthetic files and a local mock summariser, with no external endpoint. Proposed read/write roles and export restrictions are documented. The exercise found an unrestricted shared output folder; permission removal and transfer exception checks remain unverified.
E06.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E06.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E07.description: Requirements specify two staff devices and access to the local mock tool. A representative walk-through confirmed availability and usability. The technical owner exercised device failure and return to the manual template. No long-term availability record is provided.
E07.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E07.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E08.description: The proposed workflow is standalone; no automatic record integration is intended. A field map and manual copy-back rules exist. Normal copying was tested, but wrong-person matching, missing fields and rollback scenarios were not.
E08.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E08.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E09.description: The technical owner and deputy have named support roles, coverage, escalation contacts and update/exit responsibilities. A disruption exercise used an unavailable primary contact, escalated to the deputy and restored manual work. No live AI service is supported.
E09.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E09.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E10.description: Six staff covering each of three relevant roles on day and night shifts completed AI scenarios with synthetic summaries. All identified plausible errors, retained human responsibility, avoided confidential inputs and used the escalation route. One initial misconception was reassessed successfully. Agency staff are excluded from use pending induction.
E10.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E10.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E11.description: The same six staff demonstrated login, record finding, correction and error escalation using synthetic records. One worker used enlarged text and another a supported demonstration. A missed navigation step was corrected and reassessed; task/role coverage is recorded.
E11.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E11.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E12.description: A learning owner operates an induction/refresher plan with protected shift time, scenario checks, reassessment and change-triggered updates. E12.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
E12.limitations: Authored scenario facts only; no real provider, interviews, documents or tests exist.

E13.description: The pre-use review checklist requests intended purpose, supplier evidence, safety and information-governance input, conditions and re-review triggers. E13.scope: Willow fictional organisation; Non-live local mock handover summarisation; synthetic records only; no clinical recommendation or live record write-back.
